description: This Rust source file provides shared input validation helper functions for CLI inputs, including directory path validation, resource name validation, and URL path encoding, with extensive tests.

methods.name: validate_safe_output_dir
methods.description: Validates that a directory path is safe for output, ensuring it is relative, within CWD, and canonicalized.

methods.name: validate_safe_dir_path
methods.description: Validates that a directory path is safe for reading, following symlinks and staying within CWD.

methods.name: reject_control_chars
methods.description: Rejects strings containing null bytes or ASCII control characters.

methods.name: normalize_non_existing
methods.description: Resolves a path that may not exist yet by canonicalizing existing prefix and appending remaining components.

methods.name: encode_path_segment
methods.description: Percent-encodes a string for use as a URL path segment, encoding all non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: encode_path_preserving_slashes
methods.description: Percent-encodes each segment of a path, preserving slashes for hierarchical names.

methods.name: validate_resource_name
methods.description: Validates multi-segment resource names, preventing traversal, control characters, and URL-specific characters.

methods.name: validate_api_identifier
methods.description: Validates API identifiers to contain only allowed characters, preventing path traversal and injection.
